MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Neosmuk magnetic hooks fit my immediate interest in hanging things on metal surfaces, matching both of my recent magnetic-hook purchases.",
    "Another set of magnetic hooks feels like a plausible next purchase because I could use it for an additional hanging spot, although I would still want to check its holding strength."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors, electrical tape, and heat-shrink tubing are workshop supplies, but they serve wiring jobs that I do not currently have; my recent purchases were about fastening and hanging.",
    "The cleaner, vacuum, COVID tests, gloves, and trash bags address needs I have not expressed. General usefulness does not give me a reason to choose them now.",
    "The duct tape could help with repairs, but I have no outdoor patching task, and the large glove and trash-bag packs exceed my current needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in a few hardware items seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or maintenance supply.",
    "Buying assortments of fasteners seems to have been treated as a reason to offer bulk supplies for unrelated tasks."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Two recent magnetic-hook purchases are a stronger clue to what I might choose next than a broad connection to household maintenance.",
    "The purpose of an item matters to me: hanging and fastening are relevant right now, while wiring, cleaning, and medical supplies require a separate need.",
    "I rarely choose something just because it might be useful someday; it needs to fit an immediate task and a quantity I can use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical hardware, but only the magnetic hooks closely matched my current hanging and fastening needs."
}
